motds.body: Make your choice and settle the score… do you side with The Foundation or The Ice King? Choose your Team, win Rivalries, and climb the Leaderboard to unlock new loot!

motds.body: Play with Finger Guns and sizeable servings of Slapperoni Pizza in Battle Royale. Earn 5x Rivalry Credits and Supercharged XP all day! Jump into the Battle Royale Power Hour at 3:30 PM ET for The Epilogue and more.
